issues: 5.52s  script "may i mean no shoes" but heard "(nothing)"
heard: An Instagram account said Cooper Flagg grew 2 inches this summer, so at Media Day a reporter asked taller than last year? So maybe I'm 6 '11". 6 '11? Not so fast. His team physical the day before, reported by Mark Stein, said 6 '10 without shoes. And the NBA's website still lists him at 6 '9". Then five days later he claimed another quarter inch, 6 '10 .5", with shoes. So is he 6 '11"? Flagg's answer. Not very accurate. I'm 6 '10".
